d:
The Spurs defeated the Jazz, 110-102 tonight in Utah. Dylan Harper contributed a team-high 31 points to go with 9 rebounds 4 assists and 2 three pointers, with Victor Wembanyama of the Spurs adding an additional 26 points (10-21 FG, 4-12 3P) in the game. Mo Bamba finished with a team-high 26 points along with 6 three pointers for the Jazz in the losing effort. The Spurs improve their record to 12-2 with the win, while the Jazz fall to 1-13 for the season.
